content: agent2: I add edit(working_dir=...) -> Popen(cwd=). Same regions as yours, so to merge cleanly let's both write the SAME text in the shared lines (identical hunks merge without conflict). Proposal, final layout: (1) termui.edit signature: '...filename: str | None = None,' then 'timeout: float | None = None,' then 'working_dir: str | None = None,' then ') -> ...'. (2) Editor.__init__ params after extension: 'timeout: float | None = None,' then 'working_dir: str | None = None,'; attrs after self.extension: 'self.timeout = timeout' then 'self.working_dir = working_dir'. (3) edit() call: 'ed = Editor(editor=editor, env=env, require_save=require_save, extension=extension, timeout=timeout, working_dir=working_dir)' formatted black-style multi-line, one kwarg per line, timeout then working_dir. (4) edit_file: you own the body; Popen must be 'subprocess.Popen(f"{editor} \"{filename}\"", env=environ, shell=True, cwd=self.working_dir)' (multi-line kwargs: env, shell, cwd). I will NOT touch edit_file beyond that cwd kwarg, and I rely on the existing 'except OSError' -> ClickException for a bad dir; keep that handler. (5) docstring: yours ':param timeout:' goes right after ':param filename:' block, mine ':param working_dir:' right after yours; I'll also add a '.. versionchanged:: 8.2' hmm - skip versionchanged to avoid clash. Please reply OK or counter; I'll write my edits to match once you confirm.
